page.overview:
What is Arrow Cross House?

The Arrow Cross House (アロークロスハウス-Arōkurosuhausu) is a Stand and main body of Reimi Sugimoto which is featured in the JORGE JOESTAR light novel. It is the evolved form of Cube House. Penelope de la Rosa is the user who unknowingly wields the Stand.

In Chapter 4, the Arrow Cross House stands on the largest hill in Morioh, which is next to the beach. The building is in a cross-shaped form which there are four points shaped like an arrow. Each arrow has two doors and all eight can be used to get inside. thumb|A diagram of the Arrow Cross House |left|186x186px

In Chapter 4, Jorge visits the Arrow Cross House where the murder of Tsukumojuku took place. On his way, he meets the owner of the house, Rohan Kishibe, who is a famous manga artist. Rohan introduces himself and brings Jorge into the house and explains its origin. He explains that the house had appeared out of nowhere a while back, and no one knew who owned it. Despite its size, none of the neighbors knew who built it. The house never had any documents filed for its placement, but it had come from the town of Nishi Akatsuki. Rohan states that he had bought the house before the city decides to demolish it because his previous residence had burned down. Rohan explains that he had met Reimi Sugimoto, who lives with him now as a guest, because he had learned that she had amnesia. He attempted to use Heaven's Door on her, but couldn't find anything about her past.

The Arrow Cross House is able to repair any damage done to itself. As Kars' spacecraft crashes down to Earth on top of the house, it creates a large dent on the floor, it is later fixed by Reimi. Though the House is not able to restore any of the furniture inside.
